ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated tail latency observed on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings in us-west-2 starting ~21:10 UTC. Paging on-call: @oncall-oliver. Root cause unknown, investigation started.

oncall-oliver: Seeing the spike. Reproduced via a synthetic probe — p50 ok, p99 up from ~800ms to ~3.2s. Kicking off trace collection and route-level histogram. Assigning to @jamie-sre for infra-level.

jamie-sre: I have a couple of hosts with unusually high GPU utilization + kernel contention. Pulling logs now. Can we limit traffic to dedicated pool as a quick mitigation?

maria-g: FYI product impact: internal dashboards show ~12% of requests hitting the affected pool; key customers in APAC might see degraded latency for chat flows. Need a short, clear status page update once we have confirmed scope.

karen-m: Support, start compiling affected customer list. @ash-support, can you open an internal ticket and tag customers who reported slow responses since 21:05 UTC?

ash-support: On it. I have 3 inbound tickets already from early adopters; adding a broadcast draft for customers experiencing slowness. Will post here for review.

jamie-sre: Quick mitigation plan options: 1) route new traffic to healthy dedicated nodes (fast, low risk), 2) restart a subset of guilty nodes (medium risk), 3) rollback recent infra kernel patch (higher risk). Recommend option 1 first while we dig deeper.

oncall-oliver: Agreed. Can we flip routing by policy? If so, prefer non-disruptive route change.

jamie-sre: We can. Pushing a routing policy to prefer pool-b and avoid pool-a. Command: ```rbctl route update --avoid-pool pool-a --priority=high --region us-west-2``` Doing a staged push (5% -> 25% -> 100%). I'll post progress.

ops-bot: ACTION: routing change started (5% traffic). Monitor for 2 minutes and report.

jamie-sre: 5% done. p99 drops to ~2.1s. Proceeding to 25%.

oncall-oliver: 25% done. p99 now ~1.3s. Proceed to 100%.

ops-bot: Routing change completed to healthy pool. System metrics show continued improvement.

maria-g: Good. Time to draft a concise status page initial update. I made a short candidate below — please comment inline.

sam-product: Posting suggested public copy v1: ```We are investigating increased response times for text generation and embeddings in our us-west-2 region. Some requests currently see slower than normal responses. Our engineers have implemented routing changes to reduce impact and are actively investigating root cause. We will update this page as we have more information. Affected services: Text generation (POST /v1/generate) and Embeddings (POST /v1/embeddings).```
